chunks: Everything in this book that is from Aban ibn Taghlib, I have narrated from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Ali, the companion of al-Kalal, from Aban ibn Taghlib.
His kunyah was Abu Sa'id, and he was a Kindi from Kufah. He passed away during the days of al-Sadiq عليه السلام.
Then Jamil mentioned him in his presence, so he said: “May Allah have mercy on him. Indeed, by Allah, the death of Aban has truly pained my heart.”
And he عليه السلام said to Aban ibn 'Uthman: “Indeed, Aban ibn Taghlib has narrated many narrations from me, so whatever he narrates to you from me, then narrate it from me.”
And he indeed met al-Baqir and al-Sadiq عليهما السلام and narrated from them.

key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: A supplication for Allah's mercy upon the deceased.
key_terms.رِوَايَةً كَثِيرَةً: A large number of narrations transmitted from the Imam.
key_terms.كِنْدِيٌّ كُوفِيٌّ: A man of the Kindah tribe from Kufah.
key_terms.مَوْتُ أَبَانٍ: The death of Aban ibn Taghlib, noted here as a moment of grief.
key_terms.يُكَنَّى أَبَا سَعِيدٍ: His kunyah or patronymic designation was Abu Sa'id.

ai.seo_question: What does Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih say about the chain and status of Aban ibn Taghlib?
ai.summary: This passage gives the transmission chain to Aban ibn Taghlib and provides a brief biographical notice about him. It highlights his reliability and stature by recording the praise of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام and affirming that Aban narrated extensively from both Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq عليهما السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Aban ibn Taghlib has been transmitted by me from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Sa'd ibn Abdullah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu Ayyub, from Abu Ali, the companion of Al-Kilal, from Aban ibn Taghlib.
He was known by the kunya Abu Sa'id and was a Kindite from Kufa. He passed away during the lifetime of Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as).
When Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was informed of his death, he praised him and said: "May Allah (swt) have mercy on him. By Allah (swt), the death of Aban has truly pained my heart."
The Imam (as) also said to Aban ibn 'Uthman, "Indeed, Aban ibn Taghlib has narrated many traditions from me, so whatever he narrates to you from me, narrate it from me."
Aban ibn Taghlib met both Imam Al-Baqir and Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon them) and narrated from them.
